column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be to:—

column2: assist  the  relevant  authorities    to  take  steps  to
promote wellbeing of Buddha Sasana;
assist  the  relevant  authorities  to  take  steps  to
promote the development of Bikku society;
assist  the  relevant  authorities  in  promoting  the
development  and  rehabilitation  of  the  Buddhist
Temples situated in remote areas;
assist the relevant authorities in ensuring a cordial
relationship between the Buddhist monks and the
lay  Buddhists;
assist the relevant authorities to develop "Dhamma
School  Education”;
assist the relevant authorities to act for the welfare
of the teachers and students of Dhamma Schools;
assist the relevant authorities to enhance and protect
the Buddhist heritage from external influences;
assist the relevant authorities to propagate Buddhist
customs  among  the  Buddhist  adherents  and  take
necessary steps to protect the same; and
coordinate with, supervise and provide guidelines
to  the  district  and  provincial  branches  of  the
Corporation  to  achieve  the  objectives  of  the
Corporation.
